entry.value: alternating predator/prey co-evolution evaluated against a sampled set of the other side's top individuals (opponentSampleSize), rather than a single frozen champion. Tied specifically to the predatorprey.PredatorPrey problem.

propentry.description: Size of EACH population (predator and prey each get this many).
Generations each side evolves before swapping to the other.
Number of top opponent candidates (K) frozen at each swap and evaluated against; fitness is averaged over K. Higher K = more accurate but K times slower.
Total generations across BOTH sides combined.
Fraction of each population carried over unchanged each generation.
How strongly a mutated weight is perturbed.
Per-weight probability of mutation, passed into the representation's own mutate() call.
Number of candidates compared per tournament-selection draw.
Save a .zre every N generations (1 = every generation).
